traceDiagram.title: Load and publish team flow diagram
traceDiagram.description: This diagram shows how the team page loads a trainer through `useTrainer()` and renders the team of that trainer. It also shows what happens when the user publishes the team, and how the request reaches the API through `publishTeam()`.

traceNodes.label: Loads one trainer by its id
traceNodes.description: When the user opens the app, [`TeamPage` calls this hook with `trainerId` 1](code:src/pages/team/TeamPage.tsx#L16). After the first render, React runs [the effect of the hook](code:src/hooks/use-trainer.ts#L8-10), and the effect calls `request()` with `/trainers/1`.

Requests the trainer again each time the id changes

traceNodes.label: Shows the team of one trainer with a Publish button
traceNodes.description: When the user opens the app, [`main.tsx` renders this page](code:src/main.tsx#L11) with `trainerId` 1 and `maxSlots` 6. When the user clicks Publish the team, the handler of the button calls `publishTeam()`.

children.label: Shows the number, name and type of one Pokemon
